quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: The difference between greed and ambition is a greedy person desires things he isn't prepared to work for.
quotes.author: Habeeb Akande

quotes.quote: To know how to grow old is the master work of wisdom, and one of the most difficult chapters in the great art of living.
quotes.author: Herman Melville

quotes.quote: My mum and dad had worked incredibly hard to afford me an education.
quotes.author: Benedict Cumberbatch

quotes.quote: Rockefeller once explained the secret of success. 'Get up early, work late - and strike oil.'
quotes.author: Joey Adams

quotes.quote: Rich will be my life if I can keep my memories full and brimming, and record them on clear-eyed mornings while I set joyously to work setting pen to holy craft.
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

quotes.quote: Married couples who work together to build and maintain a business assume broad responsibilities. Not only is their work important to our local and national economies, but their success is central to the well-being of their families.
quotes.author: Melissa Bean

quotes.quote: The work of art assumes the existence of the perfect spectator, and is indifferent to the fact that no such person exists.
quotes.author: E. M. Forster

quotes.quote: With the need for the self in the time of another / I left my seaport grim and dear / knowing good work could be made / in the state governed by both Hope and Despair.
quotes.author: Roman Payne

quotes.quote: Your environment will eat your goals and plans for breakfast.
quotes.author: Steve Pavlina

quotes.quote: Who's to say what a 'literary life' is? As long as you are writing often, and writing well, you don't need to be hanging-out in libraries all the time. Nightclubs are great literary research centers. So is Ibiza!
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  Cities & Countries

quotes.quote: I've come to the point where I never feel the need to stop and evaluate whether or not I am happy. I'm just 'being', and without question, by default, it works.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

quotes.quote: He would work through the night and sleep until lunch. There wasn't really much else to do. Make something, and die.
quotes.author: Ian McEwan,  Amsterdam

quotes.quote: There is no happily-ever-after to run to. We have to work for happiness.
quotes.author: Mary Balogh,  Simply Magic

quotes.quote: My circumstances of unrelieved responsibility and permanent distraction necessitated the short story form.
quotes.author: Raymond Carver

quotes.quote: I'm lucky to be part of a team who help to make me look good, and they deserve as much of the credit for my success as I do for the hard work we have all put in on the training ground.
quotes.author: Lionel Messi

quotes.quote: President Kennedy understood the importance of equal pay for equal work and signed historic legislation that gave women around the country hope that one day their wages would be on par with that of their male counterparts.
quotes.author: Rosa DeLauro

quotes.quote: I don't need the money, dear. I work for art.
quotes.author: Maria Callas

quotes.quote: I cannot encourage any fabrication even for the sake of making people feel good. If I were to fabricate consciously and knowingly, I would not only be ordaining myself their enemy, but also ordaining myself God's enemy.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: People who work in an environment where doing their best is recognized have a better chance of feeling good about their work.
quotes.author: Marilyn Suttle

quotes.quote: Vacation, I go there in my mind. Especially when I'm at work, getting paid for it.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

quotes.quote: Though I had success in my research both when I was mad and when I was not, eventually I felt that my work would be better respected if I thought and acted like a 'normal' person.
quotes.author: John Forbes Nash, Jr.

quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Trouble

quotes.quote: If it's knowledge and wisdom you want, then seek out the company of those who do real work for an honest purpose.
quotes.author: Edward Abbey,  Postcards from Ed: Dispatches and Salvos from an American Iconoclast

quotes.quote: What would you consider a good job?"Answered as follows:"A good job is one in which I don't have to work, and get paid a lot of money."When I heard that I cheered and yelled and felt that he should be given an A+, for he had perfectly articulated the American dream of those who despise knowledge. What a politician that kid would have made.
quotes.author: Isaac Asimov,  The Secret of the Universe

quotes.quote: Do not do what you cannot continue to deliver.For, remember, the world wants to see a continuity of delivery of set standards...!
quotes.author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

quotes.quote: If you have a painting in you, paint. If you have a song to sing, sing. Don't judge your creation. Just create it. Banish doubt and fear and step out of your own way if you have to. Write if you're a writer and invent if you're an inventor. Do what you were born to do. Only then will you know a remarkable life.
quotes.author: Toni Sorenson

quotes.quote: Nothing is born into this world without labor.
quotes.author: Rob Liano

quotes.quote: Everyone has read about or knows someone who has gone through fertility treatments. It is an emotional nightmare, fueled by false hope and the promise of a treatment that will work.
quotes.author: Ann Hood

quotes.quote: There is no prejudice that the work of art does not finally overcome.
quotes.author: Andre Gide

quotes.quote: It is the privilege of the richTo waste the time of the poorTo water with tears in secretA tree that grows in secretThat bears fruit in secretThat ripened falls to the ground in secretAnd manures the parent treeOh the wicked tree of hatred and the secretThe sap rising and the tears falling.
quotes.author: Stevie Smith,  Selected Poems

quotes.quote: Let your body work until it is spent, but keep your mind for yourself.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Hard-Boiled Wonderland and the End of the World

quotes.quote: If we were logical, the future would be bleak, indeed. But we are more than logical. We are human beings, and we have faith, and we have hope, and we can work.
quotes.author: Jacques Yves Cousteau

quotes.quote: If you use a philosophy education well, you can get your foot in the door of any industry you please. Industries are like the blossoms on a tree while philosophy is the trunk - it holds the tree together, but it often goes unnoticed.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: The least strained and most natural ways of the soul are the most beautiful; the best occupations are the least forced.
quotes.author: Michel de Montaigne

quotes.quote: Directing the mind to stay in the present can be a formidable task.
quotes.author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

quotes.quote: To be successful, one has to be one of three bees - the queen bee, the hardest working bee, or the bee that does not fit in.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

quotes.author: Edmund Hillary

quotes.author: Leonardo DiCaprio

God is still at work through the hundreds of thousands of gifted teachers and administrators, committed parents, and passionate volunteers who seek to help give our children 'a future with hope.'
quotes.author: Adam Hamilton

quotes.quote: If you work hard, and become successful, it does not necessarily mean you are successful because you worked hard, just as if you are tall with long hair it doesn't mean that you would be a midget if you were bald.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket

quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Healology

quotes.author: Don Roff
